exact_obstruction.proof: If P is invertible and the source action is I14, equivariance gives M_cc P=P and M_ct P=P. Multiplying by P^{-1} forces M_cc=M_ct=I14. The locked proper14 action is nontrivial, so no such invertible P exists.
exact_obstruction.meaning: The boundary-function directions cannot be identified with proper14 merely as the 14D span of their invariant divisor packages. The missing map must use the cohomological/function/scalar data beyond divisor-package coordinates.
